title: Four helical planets share a load unevenly when one carrier pin is 70 um out of place (the Ligata 2007 set, 1000 N m)

provenance.source: H. Ligata, Impact of system-level factors on planetary gear set behavior, PhD thesis, The Ohio State University, 2007: Table 2.1 (gears), Table 2.2 (planet angles), section 2.2 (pin errors, floating sun, 500 rpm), the thick ring (rim 13 mm, 11 splines)
provenance.assumed: normal pressure angle 22.5 deg (the dissertation's 23.04 deg is its transverse value); the profile shift sums +0.0685 split as sun 0.0685, planet 0, ring 0.0685; standard addenda and a 1.25 / 0.38 rack; a 31-tooth shaper for the ring; 25 um of thinning on every flank (a normal backlash of about 0.1 mm a mesh); bores (sun 90 mm, planets 28 mm); steel, E = 207 GPa, nu = 0.3; the ring held at its 11 splines, each 6 deg wide, free radially there; the planets' needle bearings 2e5 N/mm in every direction (the bearing maker's value the dissertation's own model used; a later model of the rig used 1.3e5)
provenance.purpose: the four-planet set of H.
